messages:
maya: Ok team — we need a tighter decision on the Optimize toolkit prioritization for next quarter. customer asks (big customers + finance) are pushing batching/caching recs first. want tradeoffs and launch gating.
liam: +1. can we list the measurable launch criteria? customers want guaranteed >=20% token-cost reduction for common config, and regression guard rails.
sofia: For regressions, ops asked for an automated eval run on the canonical prompt sets with a coverage of at least 80% of our top-50 routes. failure threshold proposal: >0.5% quality regression (nlu/score) triggers rollback.
jordan: Agree on the eval gating. Need to define what "quality regression" means: BLEU-style might not fit. propose using existing eval harness: delta on eval_score and increase in hallucination-rate.
anika: Also include latency and p99 SLOs — caching/batching can reduce cost but might increase p99 on small requests. proposal: no more than +10ms median and +30ms p99 vs baseline for locked configs.
liam: Important: some customers demand deterministic behavior for private deployments. caching recommendations must have opt-out. add an explicit flag: `optimize.cache.enable` default true for hosted, false for Private.
maya: timeline: we have 6 sprints. what are the MVP scope items vs stretch? my take: MVP = batching planner, prefix cache, eval harness integration, rollout policy. stretch = auto-tuning, quantization recs, UI in Console.
sofia: MVP instrumentation: per-route token-saved metrics, regressions per-prompt-tag, example diffs in Console. Need new telemetry schema.
jordan: Telemetry sketch:
```
metrics: {
  route_id,
  tokens_saved, 
  avg_latency_ms,
  p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms,
  eval_score_delta,
  regression_alerts_count
}
```
ops-bot: FYI: there's an infra dependency — batch planner requires runtime changes to pooling. ETA from eng-runtime is ~3 weeks after spec.
anika: Risk: if we ship aggressive batching profiles, small-route apps could see throughput thrash. Need canary config: percent rollout + fallbacks to no-batch mode when latency > threshold.
liam: OKRs tie-in: O1: Reduce hosted token cost by 15% for top 20 workloads. O2: Keep model-regression incidents at 0 for Optimize launches. these will guide prioritization.
maya: Customer asks prioritized: 1) per-route cost reports + recommendations 2) quick toggle for cache opt-out 3) eval gating for regressions.
sofia: For prompt sets: we need canonical prompts per route and a mechanism to tag new prompts. propose a `prompt-tag` taxonomy and baseline set (top-200 prompts across customers, anonymized).
jordan: Launch gating checklist draft:
- Eval harness run on baseline + candidate
- Regression delta < 0.5% AND hallucination delta < 0.3%
- p99 increase < 30ms across canary
- Observability: tokens_saved visible + alerts wired
- Rollout policy defined (canary -> linear -> full)
anika: Resource ask: ML infra to run evals daily for canary cohorts. cost estimate: ~8 A100-hours/week for 2 weeks during rollout.
maya: Decision points for PMs: pick MVP set, lock telemetry schema, set rollback thresholds. can we decide today which features are MVP vs stretch?
liam: Vote: MVP = batching planner, prefix cache, eval gating, per-route metrics, canary rollout. Stretch = auto-tune, console recs UI, quantization suggestions.
sofia: +1 from me.
jordan: +1.
anika: +1 but we need to add private deploy opt-out default as MVP.
maya: Great — consensus. next actions:
- liam to write spec PR for batching & cache MVP (due in 48h)
- sofia to draft telemetry schema and prompt-tag taxonomy (48h)
- jordan to update eval harness with gating thresholds (72h)
- anika to confirm infra ETA and cost with eng-runtime (end of week)
liam: I'll start the spec. quick note: include example config snippet in spec for rollout policy. e.g.
```
rollout: {
  mode: "canary",
  percent: 5,
  metrics: ["p99_latency", "eval_score_delta", "tokens_saved"]
}
```
maya: Thanks. We'll review PRs in Monday's roadmap sync. if anyone has customer-specific constraints (e.g., private deploy deterministic requirement) drop them here so we can fold into spec.
sofia: Adding a doc comment: anonymize prompts and strip PII before storing prompt sets.
ops-bot: Reminder: create incident postmortem template for model-regression incidents and link it to rollout policy.
maya: Perfect. Closing — we'll reconvene on Monday with PRs. :thumbsup:
